info.title: Filarr Gate local API
info.summary: The routes every Filarr Gate serves from its decrypted copy of the Filarr databases opened to it.
info.description: This is the GENERIC description: it holds for every gate. A running gate serves its EXACT description at `/openapi.json` (its databases, their typed fields, its views and saved queries), which is what client generators should read. Every call to `/v1/*` carries an app key (`Authorization: Bearer gk_…`); the Filarr token never leaves the gate. Errors are `{ "error": "<message>", "code": "<code>" }` plus details; match on `code`, the message is for people. See docs/reference/api.md and docs/reference/errors.md in the repository.

post.summary: Model Context Protocol server (JSON-RPC 2.0, streamable HTTP, JSON answers), read only
post.description: The `mcp` setting must be on (off by default) and the key needs the MCP right. Protocol versions: 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26, 2024-11-05. Tools: `list_bases`, `query_view`, `get_row`, `run_sql` (the last one needs the SQL right too). See docs/reference/mcp.md.

401.description: No app key, or an unknown one

403.description: The key has no MCP right

post.summary: Push wake-up from Filarr (not for your software)
post.description: Filarr posts `{ "a", "t", "storeId"?, "seq"?, "at" }` signed `Filarr-Notify: t=<seconds>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256 hex>` with a key derived from the token. The gate checks the signature on the raw body and a 300-second window, answers 202, and re-reads through its usual routes: a wake-up carries no content.

post.summary: A read-only SQL query (SQLite dialect) over the databases the key can read
post.description: The key needs the SQL right. Only `SELECT` and `WITH … SELECT`. One table per database (its slug), one column per field; a database that is not opened appears with its `id` only. At most 10000 rows are returned (`truncated` says when there were more); queries of 64 KiB at most.

example.sql: SELECT ville, count(*) AS n FROM clients GROUP BY ville

200.description: Columns and rows (arrays, in column order)

401.description: No app key, or an unknown one

403.description: The key has no SQL right

post.summary: Deposit a file into the deposit box linked to the access; the Filarr app files it
post.description: The key needs the `files` scope. The gate filters first (executables and scripts by extension and by signature, size up to the limit Filarr gives and never above 104857600 bytes), then seals the file for the box, sends it in chunks, and returns at once. Neither Filarr nor the gate learns where the file is filed. Send `multipart/form-data` with a `file` part (and optional `path`, `tags`, `name`), or the raw bytes with `?name=` (or an `X-File-Name` header), `&path=` and `&tags=`. Tags: 10 at most, 40 characters each.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Raw body only: the file name, with its extension

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Raw body only: the path requested inside the target folder (the Filarr app applies it if the box accepts requested paths)

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Raw body only: tags, repeated or separated by commas

name.description: Overrides the file name of the part

202.description: Deposited: Filarr holds the sealed file until a device of the owner files it

429.description: Filarr's monthly file quotas (`api_quota_files`, `api_quota_file_bytes`) or rate; `Retry-After`

get.summary: The rows of a database: filters, sort, fields, search, pagination

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page, 100 by default, 1000 at most (a larger number is served as 1000).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next` of the previous page, as received.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Fields to return, separated by commas (`id` is always returned).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort keys separated by commas; a leading `-` sorts in descending order. Empty values sort last.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Quick search in the text of the rows (the same search as in Filarr).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only the rows changed after this version (the `version` of a page you already read).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Any other parameter is a filter: `field=value` (equals) or `field[op]=value` with op in `eq`, `ne`, `lt`, `lte`, `gt`, `gte`, `contains`, `in`, `empty`. Filters combine with AND. `in` takes values separated by commas; `empty=true` or `empty=false`. Texts compare without case or accents.

X-Filarr-Version.description: The version (`seq`) of the database served.

X-Gate-Base-Status.description: Present when the database is served from its last complete copy while something is wrong (for instance `missing_key`).

401.description: No app key, or an unknown one

503.description: The database is not loaded yet, or not served (`code` says why: `base_loading`, `key_missing`…)

post.summary: Create one row (an object) or several (an array, 500 at most): one commit in Filarr
post.description: Writing needs the `write` setting of the gate (off by default), a `rw` right from Filarr, and an app key with the create right on this database. A new row gets the default values of its columns, as "New row" does in Filarr; a field given as `null` stays empty.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any unique string: the same request sent again with the same key (same app key, method and path) within 24 hours returns the first answer, with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`, and writes nothing twice. Kept in memory: a restart forgets it.

X-Filarr-Version.description: The version (`seq`) of the database served.

appKey.description: An app key created on the gate (management UI or `filarr-gate keys create`). `X-Gate-Key: gk_…` works too. Never the Filarr token.

Row.description: One field per column, named after the column (lower case, no accents, `_` between words; `Dernier contact` → `dernier_contact`). A select gives the option's label, a relation the raw ids of the linked rows, a rollup its value (`null` when its database is not opened). The exact fields of each database are in the gate's own `/openapi.json`.

RowInput.description: The fields to write, by their JSON name; `null` empties a field. `id`, `created_at` and `updated_at` are ignored. Select fields take an option label.

next.description: The cursor of the next page, or `null`

total.description: Rows that match, all pages together

version.description: The version (`seq`) of the database served

unresolved.description: Fields whose linked database is not opened to this access

scanned.description: Rows read from the tables named by the query

truncated.description: More than 10000 rows: only the first ones are returned

seq.description: Number of the deposit in the month, for this box

link.description: The state of the link with Filarr (see docs/reference/errors.md, link states)

error.description: A message for people (it may change; match on `code`)

code.description: A stable code. The local API's own codes are listed here; codes passed on from Filarr keep Filarr's name.
